rubric.evidence: Syntax is quoted verbatim from the three Chromium Blink IDL files (navigator_rtc.idl, rtc.idl, rtc_diagnostic_logging_options.idl, all fetched 2026-08-16) rather than the spec draft, because the two now disagree: the current WICG draft relocates the methods to static RTCPeerConnection members. The page discloses that drift in a dedicated #drift section with a both-shapes feature-detection example instead of smoothing it. Metadata limits (5 entries, 100 chars) and TypeError rejection trace to the draft's algorithm text; finishDiagnosticLogging's optional RTCFinishDiagnosticLoggingOptions (a change from the earlier navigator.rtc draft the v150 page recorded) is documented from both IDL and draft. OT window desktop 151-156 and ship estimate 156 read from the chromestatus OT/ship stages as updated 2026-08-12; the enterprise policy WebRtcDiagnosticLogCollectionAllowedForOrigins comes from the current listing summary and is linked.

Feature id 5091582546149376 appears in features_by_type for milestone=151 under 'Origin trial' (listing fetched 2026-08-16); slug derived from the LISTING name per invariant #1. The OT stage's desktop_first is 151, matching the listing position. The earlier v150 page for the same feature id remains untouched (its own contract); this page cross-links it in See also with an honest note that its data reflects July 2026.

8 sections: at a glance, Syntax (verbatim IDL + per-method h3 subsections with parameter/return/exception tables), Specification drift, What the app can and cannot see, Examples (live embed + snippet), Browser compatibility (interim non-BCD, labelled), Specifications, See also. reference-contract.json declares 9 inventory items (attribute, interface, 3 methods, 3 dictionaries, drift contract) with all nine dimensions resolved; claims implementation-sufficient and passes validate-artifacts structurally.

Lede leads with the privacy architecture (app only ever gets a session ID; upload goes to the vendor, not the site). The drift section explains why code written today should feature-detect both shapes. Score 4 not 5: the enterprise-policy path is described in one bullet; an admin-focused walk-through is left to the policy doc link.
